title: Decision: .gitignore excludes runtime artifacts, certs, and secrets
description: .gitignore comprehensively excludes SQLite runtime files (*.sqlite, *.db-journal, *.db-wal), TLS certificates and keys (*.pem, *.key, *.crt), environment files (.env, .env.local), and build artifacts. Prevents accidental commit of secrets, certificates, and mailbox data—critical for a service where each user's mailbox is their only data store.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — rationale note affirming .gitignore coverage is correct. Not a finding. No action needed.
